 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Bansal

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 117/2018 under sections 498A/304B/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station Chhawala on the ground of settlement between the parties vide settlement deed dated 11th April, 2023 which is on record of this court.
2. Learned APP had vehemently opposed the quashing of the aforesaid FIR, which was noted in the order dated 15th May, 2023 passed by this court.
3. Thereafter, none has appeared on behalf of the petitioner.
4. It appears that the petitioner is not interested in pursuing the present petition.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/10/2023 at 17:53:35 5.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
